deep.reconstruction:
There is no mathematical derivation on this page. It is the opening of a fair-copy draft of the introduction to Riemann's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen', published in Crelle's Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik 54 (1857). Translated, the text reads: 'Theory of Abelian functions, by B. Riemann. In the following treatise I have treated the Abelian functions by a method whose principles were set out in my Inaugural dissertation [Göttingen 1851, Grundlagen für eine allgemeine Theorie der Functionen einer veränderlichen complexen Grösse] and presented in a somewhat altered form in the three papers No. [blank] of this Journal. To make the overview easier I give a short summary of contents first. The first part contains the theory of a system of equally-branched (gleichverzweigt) algebraic functions and of integrals of such functions'. The page breaks off there.

The three papers meant are the preparatory articles printed just before the main paper in Crelle 54:
(1) 'Allgemeine Voraussetzungen und Hülfsmittel für die Untersuchung von Functionen unbeschränkt veränderlicher Grössen'.
(2) 'Lehrsätze aus der analysis situs für die Theorie der Integrale von zweigliedrigen vollständigen Differentialien'.
(3) 'Bestimmung einer Function einer veränderlichen complexen Grösse durch Grenz- und Unstetigkeitsbedingungen'.

In the draft, Riemann left a blank after 'No' for the journal numbers. The printed version replaces this with 'in den drei vorhergehenden Aufsätzen' ('in the three preceding papers'). The printed version also reads 'von gleichverzweigten algebraischen Functionen und ihren Integralen' ('and their integrals') instead of the draft's 'und von Integralen solcher Functionen' ('and of integrals of such functions'). It continues 'soweit für dieselbe nicht die Betrachtung von Thetareihen massgebend ist' ('insofar as the consideration of theta series is not decisive for it'). The page's only interest is as a textual variant: it is an earlier redaction showing that the cross-reference to the preparatory papers was still unfilled.

results.what: Programmatic introduction to the theory of Abelian functions. It treats them via the method of the 1851 dissertation (Riemann surfaces, Dirichlet principle) and announces a first part on systems of equally-branched algebraic functions and their integrals.
results.modern_name: Riemann's theory of Abelian integrals on compact Riemann surfaces (algebraic curves); introduction to the 1857 Crelle paper

deep.surprise_reason: This is a draft of the well-known published introduction to Riemann's 1857 paper, with only minor wording variants and a blank left for the cross-reference. It contains no new mathematics.
transcription_corrections: The author line reads 'von B. Riemann'. In the Kurrent hand the 'B' resembles an 'L', but 'B.' is certain from context.
After 'in den drei Aufsätzen No' a blank space is deliberately left, presumably for the Crelle article numbers. The printed version reads 'in den drei vorhergehenden Aufsätzen'.
The last line reads 'und von Integralen solcher Functionen'. This is correct for the draft, but the printed text has 'und ihren Integralen'.
The pencil number '127' in the right margin is the archival foliation, not part of Riemann's text.
